summary: Both new scheme-level proofs reach their statements through undocumented definitional equalities — `op (coordinateHopfAlgebra R G) ≡ E.inverse.obj G` across `rightOp`/`op` wrappers, and an `AlgCat`-vs-`FiniteLocallyFreeBicommutativeHopfAlgCat` instance-path identification — even though the upstream file supplies named comparison isos for exactly this purpose.
